threshold: source-validation client-macro MCC; tie Recall then lower threshold
source_splits: unchanged frozen v3 per-client train/validation; no global cross-client grouping
features: all numeric metrics including LOC; common ordered schema within each family
source_scaling: Per-project MinMax; fit source train, public features, target unlabeled features separately; declared study preprocessing
public_selection: camel and ar1 follow paper; largest project by sample count in new families, no outcome-based selection
public_sampling: without replacement; min(700, available records), matching author code
local_resampling: fixed random oversampling of source training only to equal class counts
aggregation: oversampled private training row count weighted FedAvg followed by LHA-weighted logit distillation; author Client.train calls set_sample_number(num)
scheduler_fixes: local ReduceLROnPlateau(mode=max,patience=3,factor=.2) receives training accuracy; KD mode=min,patience=1 receives mean KL loss
implementation: Author-code-guided portable reimplementation with explicit bug fixes; NOT an untouched author run
author_fixes: resolve placeholder loader; preserve Client.train oversampled row counts for aggregation
